From 6b606216e03fa2b53cc179d8383b683a140fe6e1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Srinivasan Shanmugam <srinivasan.shanmugam@amd.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 18:16:51 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amd/ras: Fix NULL deref in
 ras_core_ras_interrupt_detected()
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Fixes a NULL pointer dereference when ras_core is NULL and ras_core->dev
is accessed in the error path.

Fixes: 13c91b5b4378 ("drm/amd/ras: Add rascore unified interface function")
Reported by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@linaro.org>
Cc: YiPeng Chai <YiPeng.Chai@amd.com>
Cc: Tao Zhou <tao.zhou1@amd.com>
Cc: Hawking Zhang <Hawking.Zhang@amd.com>
Cc: Christian König <christian.koenig@amd.com>
Cc: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Srinivasan Shanmugam <srinivasan.shanmugam@amd.com>
Reviewed-by: Tao Zhou <tao.zhou1@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/ras/rascore/ras_core.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/ras/rascore/ras_core.c
index bbf13c076a94..ad3dfe531654 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/ras/rascore/ras_core.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/ras/rascore/ras_core.c
@@ -550,7 +550,9 @@ bool ras_core_ras_interrupt_detected(struct ras_core_context *ras_core)
 		ras_core->sys_fn->detect_ras_interrupt)
 		return ras_core->sys_fn->detect_ras_interrupt(ras_core);
 
-	RAS_DEV_ERR(ras_core->dev, "Failed to detect ras interrupt!\n");
+	if (ras_core && ras_core->dev)
+		RAS_DEV_ERR(ras_core->dev, "Failed to detect ras interrupt!\n");
+
 	return false;
 }
 
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Patch Modifications

### File Modified
- `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/ras/rascore/ras_core.c`

### Modification
- **Bug Fix**: In the `ras_core_ras_interrupt_detected()` function, a NULL pointer dereference occurred when `ras_core` was passed as `NULL` and the error log attempted to access `ras_core->dev`.
- **Change**: Added a conditional check (`if (ras_core && ras_core->dev)`) before calling `RAS_DEV_ERR()` in the fallback error path. This prevents the dereference when `ras_core` is `NULL` or its `dev` member is `NULL`.
- **Before**:  
  ```c
  RAS_DEV_ERR(ras_core->dev, "Failed to detect ras interrupt!\n");
  ```
- **After**:  
  ```c
  if (ras_core && ras_core->dev)
      RAS_DEV_ERR(ras_core->dev, "Failed to detect ras interrupt!\n");
  ```

### Relationship
- The single file change directly addresses the reported NULL pointer dereference by guarding the access to `ras_core->dev` with a validity check. No other files or functions are affected. The fix ensures the error path is safe even when the RAS core context pointer is invalid.

drm/amd/ras: Fix NULL deref in
 ras_core_ras_interrupt_detected()
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Fixes a NULL pointer dereference when ras_core is NULL and ras_core->dev
is accessed in the error path.

Fixes: 13c91b5b4378 ("drm/amd/ras: Add rascore unified interface function")
Reported by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@linaro.org>
Cc: YiPeng Chai <YiPeng.Chai@amd.com>
Cc: Tao Zhou <tao.zhou1@amd.com>
Cc: Hawking Zhang <Hawking.Zhang@amd.com>
Cc: Christian König <christian.koenig@amd.com>
Cc: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Srinivasan Shanmugam <srinivasan.shanmugam@amd.com>
Reviewed-by: Tao Zhou <tao.zhou1@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>

Here is the root cause:
The function `ras_core_ras_interrupt_detected()` does not validate the `ras_core` pointer before accessing `ras_core->dev` in the error path, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the function is called with a NULL argument.

Here is the patch:
 
 bool ras_core_ras_interrupt_detected(struct ras_core_context *ras_core)
 {
 	if (ras_core && ras_core->sys_fn &&
 		ras_core->sys_fn->detect_ras_interrupt)
 		return ras_core->sys_fn->detect_ras_interrupt(ras_core);
 
-	RAS_DEV_ERR(ras_core->dev, "Failed to detect ras interrupt!\n");
+	if (ras_core && ras_core->dev)
+		RAS_DEV_ERR(ras_core->dev, "Failed to detect ras interrupt!\n");
+
 	return false;
 }
